title: Treaty for the Establishment of the East African Community
parties: Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, DRC
summary: Founding treaty of the EAC establishing the Community, institutions, and pillars of integration including customs union, common market, monetary union and political federation.

title: African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights
parties: Organisation of African Unity / African Union
summary: Regional human rights instrument protecting civil, political, economic, social and cultural rights; justiciable in Kenya through Article 2(5) of the Constitution.

title: International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights
summary: UN treaty on civil and political rights. Kenya is a party; relevant to fair trial, expression, and liberty under the Bill of Rights.

title: International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights
summary: UN treaty on economic, social and cultural rights relevant to Article 43 socio-economic rights jurisprudence in Kenya.

title: Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination Against Women
summary: CEDAW. Supports equality jurisprudence under Articles 27 and 60 of the Constitution of Kenya.

title: Convention on the Rights of the Child
summary: CRC. Informs Children Act and best-interests principle in Kenyan family and criminal proceedings involving minors.

title: Paris Agreement on Climate Change
summary: Climate mitigation and adaptation framework. Kenya's Climate Change Act and county climate funds implement commitments.

title: Marrakesh Agreement Establishing the WTO
summary: WTO founding agreement relevant to Kenya's trade law, tariffs and dispute settlement exposure.

title: Agreement Establishing the African Continental Free Trade Area
summary: AfCFTA. Kenya participates in continental free trade framework affecting customs and commercial regulation.

title: Geneva Conventions and Additional Protocols
summary: International humanitarian law instruments referenced in Kenya's international law obligations under Article 2(5).
